_meta.description: 跨厂商共享概念池 — 一个知识点同时生成 Cisco（英文）和 Huawei（中文）双版本

concepts.concept: OSI vs TCP/IP model comparison / OSI 与 TCP/IP 模型对比
concepts.explanation: TCP/IP application layer maps to OSI layer 5-7. TCP/IP network access layer maps to OSI layer 1-2.

cisco.text: Which OSI layer does the TCP/IP Application layer correspond to?

huawei.text: TCP/IP 模型的应用层对应 OSI 的哪几层？
options: A. 5-7 层（应用层+表示层+会话层）
D. 第 1-2 层（物理层+数据链路层）

concepts.concept: Subnet calculation / 子网计算
concepts.explanation: /28 = 255.255.255.240, 16 addresses total, 14 usable (subtract network and broadcast).

cisco.text: How many usable host addresses are in 192.168.1.0/28?

huawei.text: 192.168.1.0/28 有多少个可用主机地址？

concepts.concept: ARP protocol / ARP 协议
concepts.explanation: ARP resolves IP to MAC via broadcast request and unicast reply.

cisco.text: What is the purpose of ARP?
options: A. Resolve IP address to MAC address

huawei.text: ARP 协议的主要功能是？
options: A. 将 IP 地址解析为 MAC 地址
B. 将 MAC 地址解析为 IP 地址
C. 分配 IP 地址

concepts.concept: VLAN purpose / VLAN 作用
concepts.explanation: VLANs segment broadcast domains at Layer 2, improving security and performance.

cisco.text: What is the primary purpose of VLANs?
options: A. Segment broadcast domains at Layer 2

huawei.text: VLAN 的主要作用是什么？
options: A. 在二层隔离广播域
B. 提供三层路由功能
D. 替代 IP 子网划分

concepts.concept: Access vs Trunk port / Access 与 Trunk 端口区别
concepts.explanation: Access port carries single VLAN for end devices. Trunk carries multiple VLANs between switches.

cisco.text: Which port type carries traffic for multiple VLANs between switches?

huawei.text: 哪种端口类型可以在交换机之间传输多个 VLAN？

concepts.concept: STP root bridge election / STP 根桥选举
concepts.explanation: Root bridge is the switch with the lowest Bridge ID (priority + MAC address).

cisco.text: Which switch becomes the root bridge in STP?

huawei.text: STP 中根桥（Root Bridge）选举的依据是？
options: D. 最大的 MAC 地址

concepts.concept: OSPF neighbor states / OSPF 邻居状态
concepts.explanation: OSPF states: Down→Init→2-Way→ExStart→Exchange→Loading→Full. DR-other routers stay at 2-Way.

cisco.text: What is the stable OSPF neighbor state between two DR-other routers on a broadcast network?

huawei.text: 广播网络中两台 DR-other 路由器之间的 OSPF 邻居稳定状态是？

concepts.concept: OSPF DR/BDR election / OSPF DR/BDR 选举
concepts.explanation: DR/BDR elected by highest priority (1-255). Priority 0 means never elected. Tie-breaker: highest Router ID.

cisco.text: An OSPF interface with priority 0 will?
options: A. Not participate in DR/BDR election
D. Have priority overridden by Router ID

huawei.text: OSPF 接口优先级设为 0 的设备会？
options: A. 不参与 DR/BDR 选举
D. 优先级被 Router ID 覆盖

concepts.concept: Static route configuration / 静态路由配置
concepts.explanation: CLI differs: Cisco uses 'ip route', Huawei uses 'ip route-static'. Both need destination, mask, next-hop.

cisco.text: Which command configures a static route on a Cisco router?

huawei.text: 华为路由器上配置到达 192.168.2.0/24 下一跳 10.0.0.1 的静态路由命令是？

concepts.concept: Default route / 缺省路由
concepts.explanation: Default route (0.0.0.0/0) matches all traffic not matched by other routes. Used for internet-bound traffic.

cisco.text: A default route has which destination network and mask?

huawei.text: 缺省路由的目的网络和掩码是？

concepts.concept: Standard ACL / 基本 ACL
concepts.explanation: Standard ACL filters by source IP only. Cisco: 1-99, 1300-1999. Huawei: 2000-2999 (basic ACL).

cisco.text: What does a standard IP ACL filter on?

huawei.text: 华为基本 ACL 的匹配依据是？
options: A. 仅源 IP 地址
B. 源和目的 IP 地址

concepts.concept: NAT outbound / NAT 地址转换
concepts.explanation: NAT overload (PAT) maps multiple private IPs to one public IP using different source ports.

cisco.text: Which NAT type allows multiple internal hosts to share a single public IP?

huawei.text: 哪种 NAT 允许多个内部主机共享一个公网 IP？

concepts.concept: DHCP DORA process / DHCP 工作流程
concepts.explanation: DORA: Discover (broadcast), Offer (unicast), Request (broadcast), ACK (unicast).

cisco.text: What is the first packet sent by a DHCP client?

huawei.text: DHCP 客户端发送的第一个报文是？

concepts.concept: IPv6 link-local address / IPv6 链路本地地址
concepts.explanation: Link-local addresses (FE80::/10) are automatically assigned, used for neighbor discovery and OSPFv3.

cisco.text: What is the prefix for IPv6 link-local addresses?

huawei.text: IPv6 链路本地地址的前缀是？

concepts.concept: LACP mode / LACP 模式
concepts.explanation: LACP active initiates negotiation, passive waits. Both sides need at least one active to form a bundle.

cisco.text: Which LACP mode will actively initiate negotiations?

huawei.text: LACP 哪种模式会主动发起协商？

concepts.concept: SSH vs Telnet / SSH 与 Telnet 区别
concepts.explanation: SSH encrypts all traffic including passwords. Telnet is plaintext and insecure.

cisco.text: Why is SSH preferred over Telnet for device management?
options: A. SSH encrypts all data including passwords
D. SSH uses UDP which is more efficient

huawei.text: 为什么 SSH 比 Telnet 更适合远程管理设备？
options: A. SSH 加密所有数据包括密码
C. SSH 支持更多用户
D. SSH 使用 UDP 效率更高

concepts.concept: OSPF cost metric / OSPF Cost 计算
concepts.explanation: OSPF cost = reference bandwidth (100 Mbps) / interface bandwidth. Cost 1 for 100 Mbps Ethernet.

cisco.text: What is the default OSPF cost for a 100 Mbps Ethernet link?

huawei.text: OSPF 默认参考带宽下，100Mbps 以太网接口的 Cost 是多少？

concepts.concept: Port security / 端口安全
concepts.explanation: Port security limits MAC addresses per port. Default violation mode on Cisco: shutdown. On Huawei: shutdown (error-down).

cisco.text: What is the default port security violation mode on Cisco switches?

huawei.text: 华为端口安全的默认违规动作是？

concepts.concept: RSTP edge port / RSTP 边缘端口
concepts.explanation: Edge ports connect to end devices, immediately transition to forwarding. Cisco PortFast, Huawei edge-port.

cisco.text: What is the effect of configuring PortFast on a Cisco switch port?
options: A. Immediately transitions to forwarding state
B. Disables STP on that port
D. Converts the port to a trunk

huawei.text: 华为交换机配置边缘端口后，该端口会？
options: A. 立即进入转发状态
B. 在该端口上禁用 STP
D. 转换为 Trunk 端口

concepts.concept: BGP well-known attributes / BGP 公认属性
concepts.explanation: Well-known mandatory: AS_PATH, NEXT_HOP, ORIGIN. Must be present in all BGP updates.

cisco.text: Which attributes are well-known mandatory in BGP?

huawei.text: BGP 公认必遵（Well-known Mandatory）属性包括？

concepts.concept: VRRP purpose / VRRP 作用
concepts.explanation: VRRP provides gateway redundancy by virtualizing multiple routers into one virtual gateway. Cisco equivalent: HSRP.

cisco.text: What is the primary function of VRRP/HSRP?

huawei.text: VRRP 的主要功能是？
options: A. 提供网关冗余备份
B. 负载均衡网络流量
D. 提供 NAT 服务
